description: EPE publishes a large-format digital map of Brazil’s natural-gas transmission infrastructure and relevant production and exploration areas. The description distinguishes infrastructure and projects considered in sector planning. The provider is Empresa de Pesquisa Energética. Coverage: Coverage is Brazil. The map includes exploration blocks through the fifth pre-salt production-sharing round; a uniform currency date and map precision were not established. Access: The provider offers a publication page describing the digital map. Map files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Planned and authorised lines must be distinguished from operating infrastructure. A map is not automatically a complete or routable GIS network. For simulation it supplies a reference for network and supply-location interpretation, requiring conversion and verification before quantitative use. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
